# 2 Baruch Chapter 63 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**63:1** "And-those-bright-waters which-you-saw which-followed-those-black-waters: these-are-the-works-of-Hezekiah-king-of-Judah, and-the-coming-of-Isaiah the-prophet,"

**63:2** "who-was-a-man-of-renown and-of-great-wisdom, and-who-spoke-many-prophecies concerning-the-coming-of-the-Messiah, and-concerning-Zion, and-concerning-Israel; and-he-prayed-for-the-wrath-to-be-appeased."

**63:3** "For-Hezekiah-the-king received-the-letter, which-was-written-against-him, and-he-spread-it-out-before-the-LORD, and-he-prayed-for-the-help-of-the-LORD."

**63:4** "And-the-Mighty-One heard-him; for-Hezekiah was-righteous and-not-a-transgressor, as-some-of-the-kings-who-were-before-him had-been."

**63:5** "And-the-LORD sent-the-destroying-angel against-Sennacherib, and-he-smote-the-camp-of-the-Assyrians;"

**63:6** "and-in-that-night-the-destroying-angel killed-a-hundred-and-eighty-five-thousand-of-those-who-had-come-against-Jerusalem."

**63:7** "And-Hezekiah-the-king, when-he-was-sick-unto-death, prayed-before-the-LORD, and-the-LORD-healed-him, and-he-lived-fifteen-years-more."

**63:8** "And-also-Sennacherib, the-king-of-Assyria, was-cut-off, and-he-was-despised, and-he-returned-home in-shame."

**63:9** "And-Hezekiah-was-preserved from-all-who-had-sought-to-destroy-him, and-Judah-was-not-taken-captive-in-his-day."

**63:10** "For-Hezekiah kept-the-law, and-he-offered-upon-the-altar-of-the-LORD; and-he-established-the-passover in-Zion."

**63:11** "These-are-the-fourth-bright-waters which-you-saw."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
